title: world share link/3
description: The payload a world share link carries when its scenario is at revision 2 or more (SCENARIO_REVISIONS.md), after js/shareState.js decodePayload() has read the fragment (#3z or #3r, then base64url of the, deflated or raw, JSON). It is world-link/2 and one more key: `r`, the scenario's revision, an integer of 2 or more, required at version 3 and written only for a scenario in the registry. A link of version 1 or 2 means revision 1. The reader refuses a version 3 link whose `r` is missing, not an integer or below 2, and one whose `r` is above the revision this build holds, with the message it has for a link from a newer version; an older build refuses every version 3 fragment with that message and never rebuilds another world. A scenario is checked against the built-in ids by the reader, not here. The same payload, stamped, is what a capture of a loaded world carries inside a stored record: for a world at revision 2 or more a capture written for a record is full (`b`) and `d` holds every setting, so a build that ignores `r` still rebuilds the same settings and bodies. FORMATS.md lists it.
